quarterly_data.quarter: Huaqin Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Data center business (half-year report): the full-stack portfolio covers AI servers, general-purpose servers, switches and supernode whole-rack systems; Huaqin says it has established and consolidated core-supplier status at the leading domestic cloud service providers, and R&D and volume production on new compute platforms progressed in H1 2026. It says it was early in supernode racks, is one of very few makers with both compute-node and network-node design capability, led the drafting of the ODCC (Open Data Center Committee) ETH-X supernode whole-rack design specification in 2024, and is a core domestic supplier of supernode products, using its own manufacturing capacity to deliver whole racks in volume.
